## Call Agent
A call is a WebSocket carrying text: what you say is transcribed in the browser, sent to the agent below, and the reply is streamed back and spoken to you.

**Agent** — pick one that answers in short spoken prose. A coding agent will narrate its tool calls at you.

**Conversation** — every call resumes the same conversation, under the target `<agent>-<external id>`. Hit **new** in the call window to start a fresh one.

**Credentials** — leave the agents-platform fields blank and this app inherits them from the Agents Platform Runners app. Fill them in only to call a different platform.
